title: livingbactery
description: A Living Bactery that can eat everything in the world.
body:
🦠 Living Bactery – The World-Eating Swarm

Tiny. Fast. Hungry.
The Living Bactery may be small, but don’t underestimate it — once released, it spreads like wildfire. These worm-like microbes devour everything, from dirt and stone to oceans themselves. Blocks vanish in seconds as the swarm grows, multiplies, and consumes the world around it.

Yet even these unstoppable creatures have

a weakness: light.
Sunlight stops them in their tracks and slowly burns them away — but in the dark, nothing is safe.

For now, the Living Bactery can only be summoned with:

/summon bacteria:living_bactery


**💡 Quick Tip: Keep a world backup — once unleashed, the Living Bactery will not spare your houses. It’s always hungry.**


⚠️ Note: This is the beta version of Living Bactery. Expect bugs, chaos, and block-eating madness. More features coming soon!
